title: When a graph earns its keep
keywords: agent agents orchestration workflow workflows graph langgraph branching loop
text: Use explicit nodes and conditional edges when a workflow needs branching, bounded repair loops, or a human decision. A short, fixed sequence can remain ordinary functions.

title: Shared state is a data contract
keywords: agent agents orchestration workflow state schema context memory data
text: State carries the goal, selected evidence, draft, and validation results between nodes. Nodes return updates; reducers determine how multiple updates combine.

title: A checkpoint preserves progress
keywords: agent agents orchestration workflow state memory persistence checkpoint resume storage
text: A checkpointer stores execution progress under a thread ID. In-memory checkpoints disappear with the process; durable storage is needed to resume after a restart.

title: Pause for a person
keywords: agent agents orchestration workflow human review approval interrupt resume
text: An interrupt pauses for human input. Resume with the same thread ID. Code before the interrupt may execute again, so keep side effects after approval or make them idempotent.
